The factor-four trial with naive counting was much slower, so it does not establish a gain with this faster count; the combined program must be evaluated independently.
notes: Only src/candidate.cpp is changed. The factor-four unroll preserves update order and handles any remainder generically; uint32_t accumulation and full output overwrite remain. This is a proposal, not a measured or confirmed result.
